name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos + Darknut PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: 0.13.8 DARKNUT RESURRECTION (DKR01): the normal Darknut (Enemy Spawner, B_TN 0x000001FF) falls natively at its first defeat in the second phase, stays down for the native Ending Blow and rises ONCE (resurrection_A_pulida_FIX01) after the Finish or after 10 s with 100 % resistance; its second defeat is the full native death. Armour phase, AI and every other enemy unchanged. Chilfos (E_KK), Lizalfos and Bokoblin posture duels, Link posture bar (0.13.7 FIX07 unchanged).
